proposals.title: Advisory vote on a shareholder proposal requesting a change to the vote-counting standard for shareholder proposals
proposals.proponent: The Equality Network Foundation, represented by Investor Voice, SPC
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to amend governing documents so non-binding shareholder proposals are decided by a simple majority of votes cast FOR and AGAINST, excluding abstentions.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends voting AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Advisory vote on a shareholder proposal regarding the threshold to call special shareholder meetings
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to amend bylaws to let holders of 15% of outstanding common stock call a special shareowner meeting.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends voting AGAINST this proposal requesting that the Company take steps

proposals.title: Advisory vote on a shareholder proposal to issue a class of preferred stock with the right to elect its own Director
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to create a franchisee preferred stock class allowing franchisees to elect one Board director.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends voting AGAINST this proposal requesting that the Company take steps to create a dual-class structure

proposals.title: Advisory vote on a shareholder proposal requesting that the Board make all lawful efforts to implement and/or increase activity on the Holy Land Principles
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to make all lawful efforts to implement the eight Holy Land Principles on equal employment opportunity in Palestine-Israel.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends voting AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Advisory vote on a shareholder proposal requesting the Board to update the Company's policy regarding use of antibiotics by its meat suppliers
proposals.proponent: The Benedictine Sisters of Boerne, Texas
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to set global sourcing targets with timelines for pork and beef raised without non-therapeutic use of medically important antibiotics.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Advisory vote on a shareholder proposal requesting a report assessing the environmental impacts of polystyrene foam beverage cups
proposals.proponent: The Gun Denhart Living Trust, represented by As You Sow Foundation
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report assessing environmental and health impacts of continued use of polystyrene foam beverage cups.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends voting AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Advisory vote on a shareholder proposal requesting a report on charitable contributions
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report listing and analyzing charitable contributions for congruency with corporate values and brand risk.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends voting AGAINST this proposal requesting the Board to publish an annual report
